meta.title: Suggest a Smoking Area or No-Smoking Zone
meta.description: Pick a spot on the map to request that a new smoking area or no-smoking zone be added.

header.title: Suggest a new area
header.description: Mark a smoking area or no-smoking zone on the map to suggest it

guide.draw: Tap “Draw area”, then place at least 3 points on the map to mark the area.
guide.publish: Areas you submit are posted on the board. Once an area gets 20 or more “Correct” votes, it is added to the map automatically at 3 a.m. (Korea time) every day.

location.title: Location
location.pinMode: Tap the map to fill in the location automatically

area.title: Area
area.needMore: Place at least 3 points ({remaining} more needed)

privacyNotice: When you submit a request, the information you entered, such as the area’s location, address, building name and type, is sent and posted publicly on the board. For details, see our <link>Privacy Policy</link>.
submitFailed: Something went wrong while submitting the area. Please try again later.

success.title: Request submitted!
success.description: The area you suggested will be posted on the board. Once it gets 20 or more “Correct” votes, it is added to the map automatically at 3 a.m. (Korea time) every day.

map.label: Map for choosing a location
map.drawingHint: Tap the map to mark the area
map.pinHint: Tap the map to fill in the address automatically
